tools.name: search
tools.description: Search PermitReporter reviewed guidance and privacy-minimized collected building-permit records. Returns canonical URLs for citation. Call fetch with a returned ID for the full source.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one reviewed PermitReporter guide or one collected permit record returned by search. Permit records retain source, record date, collection timestamp and coverage limits.

tools.name: search_georgia_permits
tools.description: Search privacy-minimized collected building-permit records by public text, Georgia county, city, PermitReporter trade classification or record-date range. Returns no raw payloads or party arrays. An empty result means no matching record was collected, not that no permit exists.

tools.name: get_permit_record
tools.description: Retrieve one privacy-minimized collected building-permit record by PermitReporter record ID, including its canonical citation, official source link and collection timestamp.

tools.name: get_county_coverage
tools.description: Return the current source route, issuer, cadence, lag, through-date, collected record count, sources and statistical floor for one of Georgia's 159 counties. Call this before interpreting a missing county result.

tools.name: get_contractor_leads
tools.description: Return recent, source-linked collected permits classified by trade and project scope for contractor research. Classifications are editorial signals, not official fields or guaranteed work.

tools.name: get_statewide_snapshot
tools.description: Return current PermitReporter counts, route-status boundaries, record-date range and latest collection timestamp without returning personal data.

tools.name: create_permit_watch
tools.description: Create a pending email watch only after the user reviews the exact email, search query and optional county, explicitly authorizes this request and confirmation email, and accepts https://permitreporter.com/terms and https://permitreporter.com/privacy. This additive action stores the email and search

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, create_permit_watch · Private data: search, fetch, search_georgia_permits, get_permit_record, get_county_coverage, get_statewide_snapshot, create_permit_watch · Public sink: create_permit_watch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, create_permit_watch · Private data: search, fetch, search_georgia_permits, get_permit_record, get_county_coverage, get_statewide_snapshot, create_permit_watch · Public sink: create_permit_watch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
